visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Transparent tile (no box) beside text in a 60/30 split on a light grey band: large orange outline icon (72px) above a bold linked title and an orange chevron; whole tile linked.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Single transparent tile: large orange outline icon above a bold linked title and orange chevron, no box. cards-cta is a filled box without an icon (under 80% similar)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Linked icon tile with large icon, bold title and chevron

contentPattern.summary: Styled linked icon tile placed beside the default content; the whole tile is a link
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: [icon image | linked title]

blockContent.description: Icon tile: globe-information icon, linked title "SPARK Global" -> https://sparkglobal.io/
blockContent.notes: Title is authored as linked (bold) text, not a heading; chevron is decorative CSS

usage: One or more icon tiles, each with a large icon above a bold linked title; the whole tile is clickable and shows a chevron.
reuseGuidance: Use for an icon-led link to an external program or resource beside default content. Use cards-cta when the link should be a filled box without an icon.
